assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: photorealistic cut-reference image for Allele's denim fit quiz, NOT an actual product listing. Create one pair of unbranded women's jeans, photographed as an exquisite contemporary e-commerce flat-lay. Camera exactly overhead; garment front facing camera, waistband horizontal, two full legs laid naturally straight down, small gap between legs. Absolutely no person, body, mannequin, shoes, hands, hanger, text, labels, logos, or props. Portrait 2:3 canvas. Full garment contained, waistband near 9% from top and hems near 91%; generous side margins. Seamless warm off-white background #FFFBF7, gentle soft shadow, diffuse daylight. Highly realistic cotton twill, fine gold topstitching, belt loops, realistic metal button and rivets, gentle natural folds; restrained dark-to-medium indigo wash, no holes, no heavy distressing. Refined modern denim editorial. Prioritize believable garment construction and immediately readable leg shape; not a vector, diagram, cartoon, or shiny 3D rendering. Subject: a fashionable vintage-inspired STRAIGHT-LEG jean. High rise, clean regular width from knee to hem, moderate hip and thigh ease. Authentic medium-indigo true-blue wash. Full-length not cropped. One complete garment only.
